messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — planning to publish py/ts SDK patch (v1.14.1) during tomorrow's quiet window (05:00 UTC). It's a small compat fix + a soft-deprecate message for sync client.

kyle: SGTM. Are we pinning dist-tag or doing ephemeral dist-tag flip? last time we did `next`->`latest` pin caused some pinback churn.

anya: Prefer sticky pin: publish under `canary-2026-03-22` and then `dist-tag` flip after 24h if no issues. Also update release notes and deprecation note in README.

maria: QA: smoke tests passed on 1.14.0 patch branch. I saw a flaky Windows wheel test; will re-run in morning.

sam: If deploy-bot reports non-200 indexes, we should hold pinflip. Also add rollback tag: `rollback/1.14.1`.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Publish started: py wheel -> s3://redwood-sdk/py/1.14.1; npm -> registry (canary). CI: 5/7 jobs passed.

maria: CI jobs failing: OSX wheel signing error — `gpg: cannot open tty`. Requeuing.

anya: Ok hold on the pinflip until CI green. Kyle, can you prepare release notes draft? I'll include deprecation blurb: 'sync client deprecated, use async client; will be removed 2026-09-01'.

kyle: Draft posted: https://internal.redwood/docs/release-notes/1.14.1. Also adding migration snippet:

`````
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key=os.getenv("RW_KEY"))
`````

anya: Nice. If everything green by 08:00 UTC we flip at 09:00 UTC. If not, we rollback publish and tag `yank/1.14.1` and reopen thread.

maria: Re-run green 07:52 UTC. OSX signing fix was a missing env var on runner.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Publish completed: py wheel uploaded, npm package published to `canary-2026-03-22`. 7/7 CI jobs passed.

anya: Flipping dist-tag at 09:00 UTC — I'll coordinate in #release-ops. Hold on validation for 30m after flip; if error rates spike >0.5% we'll revert and mark rollback.

kyle: Acknowledged. I'll watch telemetry and have rollback PR ready: `revert-disttag-1.14.1`.

sam: Add note to CHANGELOG about deprecation timeline and suggest pin for enterprise customers who need stability: `pip install redwood-sdk==1.14.0`.

anya: thanks all :thumbsup:
